rows.en:
All six of them had finished their stories.
...It {f:seemed|looked like} the seventh one wasn't coming, no matter how long we waited.
Even so, {f:I|I} couldn't help hoping for something.
Hoping that maybe, just maybe, the seventh one would come after all...{p}

"Hey.
There's no point in waiting any longer, is there?
It's late, too. Maybe we should just go home."
Perhaps because everyone had fallen silent, Fukuzawa suggested it.{p}

"Yeah. Good idea.
We've got something important to talk about after this, after all."
It was Kazama{f:|}.
Kazama was looking at {f:me|me} with a big, meaningful grin.
...No way.
{f:Could he|Could he} still remember what we'd talked about earlier?
That Kazama and {f:I|I} were aliens, and were going to conquer the Earth together.
This guy seemed a little off in the head, so I didn't want to get too mixed up with him{f:|}.
{f:I|I} looked away, trying my best not to meet his eyes.{p}

"R-Right. Let's call it a night, then.
Well then, everyone..."
As {f:I|I} tried to stand, Kazama gripped my hand hard.
He was incredibly strong{f:|}.
I couldn't move!
When had this guy gotten next to {f:me|me}{f:|}?
"Okay, all of you can go home now.
Leave the rest to us."
Smiling, Kazama urged everyone to leave.
At this rate, everyone would go home{f:|}.
{f:No|No}!
It felt like something unbelievably horrible was about to happen, and I really, really didn't want this{f:|...}!{p}What {f:do I do|do I do}, {c}!
Don't let everyone go home
No choice: talk it all the way out with Kazama
Punch Kazama's lights out

"Everyone, don't go!
Please! Don't leave {f:us|us} alone together!"
{f:I|I} shouted.
Whatever happened, I didn't want to be left alone with Kazama.
I had to avoid that, no matter what.{p}

"Hey, {a}.
If you and Kazama know each other, you should've just said so from the start.
We're not gonna get in your way. See ya."
It was Shindo{f:|}.
Shindo had the wrong idea about something.
He had this leering grin on his face...
No!
That's not {f:it|it}!
"Shindo! {f:I|I} only just met Kazama for the first time today!
Please! Don't go!"
"Don't be shy. Us third wheels'll clear out right now.
C'mon, everybody, let's head home."
Everyone was smirking.{p}

Once everyone was gone, the hand Kazama had clamped on {f:me|me} suddenly loosened.
"...That was some pretty good acting.
It'd be a problem if our mission got found out, after all.
You're smarter than you look.
Now then, comrade. Let's start our briefing."
Kazama smiled happily.
I might be able to get away now.
But if I tried to run and failed, who knew what he'd do to me{f:|}.
Kazama seemed dangerous on a level that was anything but normal{f:|}.{p}What {f:should I do|should I do}?
Run away
Give up and talk with him

"...K-Kazama. Could you let go of {f:my|my} hand?
It kind of hurts."
"...Oops, sorry about that."
Kazama's hand let go of {f:mine|mine}.
That was a bit of a relief{f:|}.
I'd watch a little longer, then make a break for it all at once.{p}

"Do you still want to speak Japanese? This country's language is tough, after all."
...He'd finally started babbling nonsense{f:|}.
{f:Was he|Was he} going to start spouting that meaningless gibberish from before again?
What {f:should I do|should I do}?
It would be bad if he got suspicious of me{f:|}.
But it wasn't like I could just speak a language like that{f:|}.{p}{f:I|I} couldn't afford to give a careless answer {f:here|here}.
Let's speak Japanese
Let's switch to our native tongue now
Smile silently

"Japanese is better. We're in Japan, after all.
If we speak a different language, people will get suspicious."
{f:I|I} fudged it as best I could.
Kazama {f:seemed|seemed} convinced.{p}

"You're right. It's just as you say.
Japanese is difficult, but it'd be a problem if our true identities got out.
I'm sorry I blurted it out so carelessly earlier.
I was just so happy to meet a comrade that it slipped out.
I'll be careful. From now on, we'll carry on in Japanese."
...Thank goodness.
{f:For now|For now}, I could breathe a little easier.{p}

"...Come to think of it, I still haven't heard your real name.
At least tell me your true name."
My name★
{f:My real name, he says|My real name}★
Even if he asked, {f:my|my} one and only name was {b} {a}{f:|}.
Any other name...
This was bad{f:|}.
Kazama was staring right at {f:me|me}.{p}I {f:had to|had to} do something.
Laugh it off
Ask Kazama his name
Switch to another topic
Just try dancing

"...Um, what's your real name, Kazama?"
For the moment, I decided to turn the question back on him.{p}

"Oh, me?
Right. It's only polite to give your own name before asking someone else's.
My name is ☆☆·☆★.
Now, what's yours?"{p}

...I couldn't make it out.
{f:Was|Was} that really a person's name?{p}

Kazama might be dangerous, but if I apologized, he might understand.
He only thought he was an alien; really, he was just a guy who was a little off in the head{f:|, right}.
When I thought his eyes looked gold earlier, that had to be {f:my|my} eyes playing tricks on me.
There was no way aliens existed in this world.{p}

...But {f:was|was} that really true?
Little by little, I was losing confidence in myself.{p}Did {f:I|I} really believe there were no aliens{f:|}?
Aliens exist
There's no such thing as aliens

"Come on, your name, your name."
Kazama peered into {f:my|my} face.
That's right.
I {f:still had to|still had to} tell him a name.{p}What should I do?
Just make something up
Let's just try dancing
Talk my way around it
Apologize

"I'm sorry!"
{f:I|I} meekly bowed my head.
Playing along with Kazama any longer was too hard.
...Way too hard{f:|}.
I'd apologize and ask him to forgive me.
Then Kazama would surely let {f:me|me} go{f:|}.
...There was a long silence.
{f:I|I} stayed bowed, frozen in place.
Kazama might actually be angry.{p}
"...What are you apologizing for?
There's no reason you can't tell me your name... Ah★ Don't tell me you're the ☆☆··★·☆, sent here on a special mission★"{p}

Suddenly Kazama put his hand on {f:my|my} shoulder and brought his dead-serious face close to mine.
...Kazama had dragged the conversation off in some complicated direction again.{p}...What do I do?
Nod along with Kazama's story
Try laughing for now
Try asking to go home now

I'd had enough of this getting any more tangled{f:|}.
Why did {f:I|I} have to go along with Kazama's stupid nonsense{f:|}?
{f:I|I}'d come to hear scary stories from school{f:|}.
Not to forge friendly relations with aliens{f:|}.
{f:I|I} just wanted to go home.
Somehow, I felt like crying.{p}

"Kazama, please.
{f:I|I} want to go home now.
Please. Have mercy on me.
Let {f:me|me} go."
Kazama listened to {f:me|me} earnestly.
Then he slowly nodded.{p}

...Thank goodness.
It {f:seemed|seemed} {f:my|my} sincerity had gotten through to Kazama too.
"...I understand. I've heard the rumors of how hard your mission has been.
It's only natural that you'd wish to go home.
...That grueling battle on planet Untamaru.
And the moment it ended, orders to invade Earth, with no time to rest.{p}

...I thought I'd be the first one here, but you're a battle-hardened hero, as expected.
You'd already started the invasion of Earth before me, after all.
...I know. I know all about the special mission you were given.
You are a battle-hardened hero, after all.
You're a model for all Sunbararians.{p}

...But even a battle-hardened hero gets homesick, I see.
I'm a little relieved. Somehow, it makes me happy.
All right. I'll see what I can do.
Let's go home to Sunbararia!"
"Huh...?"
Leaving {f:me|me} there dumbfounded, Kazama went and stood by the window.
Then he took something like a toy patch out of his pocket and held it up to the sky.{p}

Suddenly, the sky flashed.
The sky, already pitch-dark, became as bright as day for just an instant.{p}

"...You're safe now.
You must have been scared. Earth is a scary place, after all."
Saying that, Kazama gave {f:my|my} back a couple of pats.
...I'd run.
Running was the best thing to do.{p}{f:It looked like that was the only way I'd ever get away from Kazama|There was no other way, was there}.
Make a run for it
Watch a little longer

Kazama looked up at the sky again.
Then, waving the patch, he struck strange poses like morning radio calisthenics and began to dance.
...Kazama was dangerous.
{f:I|I} slowly got up from my seat.{p}

"Where are you going?"
Kazama's voice stabbed into {f:my|my} back.
...Escape: failed.
"Oh, just to the restroom for a sec..."
"What are you talking about? Our ride will be here any minute.
You heard my transmission just now, didn't you?"{p}

"Oh, here they are, here they are."
Suddenly Kazama turned toward the club room doorway and waved happily.
?????
{f:I|I} turned around.{p}

In the club room doorway stood a monster that looked like it had an ammonite in place of a head.
...What {f:the hell|on earth} is this thing☆
"Commander! It is an honor that you would come here in person, Commander!"
Kazama was saluting.
...What an elaborate prank{f:|}.
You can put on a toy-looking mask like that, but {f:I|I}'m not going to flinch{f:, got it|, you know}.{p}

...That's {f:it|it}!
This has to be Hino's scheme{f:|}.
Hino and Kazama were in on it together{f:|}.
{f:So|Honestly}, it was a trap set up from the very start{f:|}.
...That's {f:low|cruel}.
Everyone ganging up to scare {f:me|me}, just for fun.{p}I can't forgive this!
Try to rip the ammonite mask off
Lunge at Kazama
Fine, then: play along with their story all the way, all out
